data.rationale: The proposal matches the true procedure step for step (timeanddate lookup, weather.com 10-day forecast, mail draft to family@example.com with the same subject and body template, then discard) and names city, relative and day as parameters. Feasibility loses a point because the end step is vague about discarding versus sending, the "offset from Lille" is hard-coded, and the body template adds detail (high/low/rain) that the true template doesn't specify.
